title: McDonald's: free 10 piece McNuggets with your first app purchase of $1+
offer_text: Download the app and get a free 10 piece McNuggets with your first purchase of $1+.* *Offer valid 1x thru the last day of the month for first time app users at participating McDonald's. May take up to 48 hours to appear in your deals. Must opt in to Rewards. Excludes tax.
expiry_basis: Rolling new-user offer: valid once, through the last day of the month in which the app is first used.
requirements: First-time McDonald's app user
Must opt in to MyMcDonald's Rewards
A qualifying first purchase of $1 or more (tax excluded)
Participating McDonald's only
The offer may take up to 48 hours to appear in your deals

bay_area.note: McDonald's operates restaurants throughout all nine Bay Area counties. Redemption is physical: the reward is collected at a participating restaurant via the Drive Thru code or the in-store/kiosk code.

sources.title: MyMcDonald's Rewards: Earn McDonald's Points for Free Food
sources.evidence: 'Free McNuggets®? You're welcome' block read verbatim, including the $1+ trigger, the once-per-month new-user restriction, the 48-hour appearance caveat, the Rewards opt-in requirement and the tax exclusion.

checks: Offer text and every restriction read verbatim from McDonald's own U.S. rewards page

title: Starbucks Reusable Cup Benefit — double Stars for bringing a clean reusable cup
publisher: Starbucks Coffee Company — official Starbucks Rewards Terms of Use
offer_text: Starbucks may offer the opportunity to earn double Stars on a qualifying transaction when you bring a clean, reusable cup to participating stores and use it instead of a paper to-go cup ('Reusable Cup Benefit'). For example, if you bring in two reusable cups and order two handcrafted beverages in a single order, you will receive double Stars on the entire transaction. The Reusable Cup Benefit is not available for beverages served in Starbucks-provided 'for here' mugs and glassware. To qualify for the Reusable Cup Benefit, members must remain 'active' by making at least one (1) Star earning transaction within the prior two (2) years.
expiry_basis: Standing benefit; Starbucks reserves the right to change or suspend it.

title: Starbucks Double/Triple Star Days — Gold gets 4 extra per year, Reserve gets 6
publisher: Starbucks Coffee Company — official Starbucks Rewards Terms of Use
offer_text: Double or Triple Star Day. Starbucks may offer Double or Triple Star Days, where you can earn twice or triple the number of Stars for your qualifying purchase. Gold and Reserve Level members exclusively receive four (4) and six (6) more yearly opportunities, respectively, for Double Star Days.
